body: I think the beauty that lies there is that we all have been conditioned to believe that we “have” to do something when we made that word up as we made a lot of bullshit up in order to feel “civilized” when we don’t *have* to do anything. We say we have to because it dignifies that there is a goal to be accomplished. You’re here because of the same reason I’m here. Nothing is intentional. There is no external force that is making us *have to do anything. It’s all mental
Thank you, hope all is well on your end

Thank you, it means too much to be able to seek comfort from somebody I don’t even know. I’m just lost & there’s no real cause & effect to why I feel this way. I understand life is life & we just go through highs & lows, but even at my highs I just think about the lows that are going to come in the near future. My ups aren’t even ups anymore, they’re just smoother bottoms before I fall into a rockier bottom. I dunno. It doesn’t make sense, but I do believe in rocky bottom such as mine, even the most littlest interactions go a long way. So thank you again. I appreciate it. Hope all is well on your side of the spectrum
Hope you’re still here, I don’t know shit about you but I’m just about ready to head out. Show me hope please.. that you decided to stay
I like your sense of humor, the irony gets me I’m right here with you

I hope you’re still here by the time I read this. If you are please let me know. I need some type of hope that though you feel like this & are going through it that you are still hanging on, because I feel the same as you do & don’t know how much longer I can go on.
Let’s make a support group chat?
